title: Spec-Driven PBT: Deriving Semantic Invariants from Code Specifications for Agentic Property-based Testing
abstract: arXiv:2611.15920v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Software is increasingly written by AI agents that produce an implementation from a natural language specification, a practice known as agentic coding. Code is now produced faster than it can be reviewed, and has been shown to exhibit its own characteristic failure patterns. Property-based testing (PBT), a long-standing technique in which invariant properties of a program are checked against many generated inputs, has recently been revisited with LLM agents authoring the properties, thereby removing the high-effort derivation of invariants that has long hindered its adoption. Existing methods, however, derive these properties from the implementation alone (Code-driven PBT). At the same time, a thorough specification such as a product requirements document has become routine within agentic coding, yet its role in testing the resulting code remains underexplored. translated_title: 规格驱动的属性测试（Spec-Driven PBT）：从代码规格说明中推导语义不变量以实现智能体式基于属性的测试
translated_abstract: 软件越来越多地由AI智能体编写，即智能体根据自然语言规格说明生成代码实现，这种做法被称为智能体编程。如今代码的产生速度已超过人工审查的速度，并且已被证明会表现出其特有的失败模式。基于属性的测试是一种历史悠久的测试技术，它通过大量自动生成的输入来检验程序的不变属性。最近，这一技术被重新审视，由LLM智能体来编写测试属性，从而消除了长期以来阻碍其推广的高成本不变量推导工作。然而，现有方法仅从代码实现本身推导这些属性（即代码驱动的PBT）。与此同时，详尽的规格说明（如产品需求文档）已成为智能体编程流程中的常规产物，但其在测试所生成代码中的作用仍鲜有探索。我们研究了规格说明作为测试属性来源的价值……
tldr: 该论文提出规格驱动的属性测试方法，利用智能体编程中已有的自然语言规格说明（而非仅从代码实现）来推导语义不变量，从而更有效地测试AI生成的代码。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Spec-Driven PBT, which derives semantic invariants from natural language specifications readily available in agentic coding workflows—rather than from the implementation alone—to enable more effective property-based testing of AI-generated code.
